lines: London, 1837. Something leaps over garden walls at night.
People say it wore a black cloak and a pointed helmet.
Its eyes glowed like burning coals, and it spat blue fire.
Witnesses swore it jumped fences no man could clear.
Legend says its boots had springs, so they called it Spring-heeled Jack.
Even the Lord Mayor of London read out the reports.
Crowds hunted it on Clapham Common, but it always vanished.
Nobody ever caught it, and sightings went on for decades.
Was it a prank, or something else? Would you walk home alone?
title: The Leaping Devil of Victorian London 😱 Spring-heeled Jack #shorts
description:
In 1837, London was terrified by a cloaked figure that leapt over walls and breathed blue fire. Legend says his boots had springs. Prank, panic, or something stranger? This is the legend of Spring-heeled Jack.
